Eli (docs): starting a tiny 'migration sparkline' note for Optimize toolkit — single-screen, 3 copy-paste snippets: batching json, kv-prefetch minimal SDK, short quant recommendation. keep it snappy. objections?
Arun (eng): no objections. include streaming auth hint (SSE header) and make batching JSON ready for Dedicated.
Maya (opt): add one short sentence about auto vs manual batching: when to trust auto and when to cap.
Jo (pm): product blurb: "Expected wins: lower p95 and unit cost; watch short-sequence regressions." one line.
Eli (docs): drafting. Arun, paste 3-line kv-prefetch snippet?
Arun (eng):```python
from redwood import Client
cli = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
res = cli.generate("tl;dr: keep it short", prefetch_kv=True)
```
Eli (docs): perfect. Maya, quant 1-liner?
Maya (opt): "Choose int8 for high-throughput batch workloads; use fp16/bf16 for latency-sensitive short inputs. Run a 50-sample smoke eval before rollout."
Eli (docs): batching JSON (copy/paste):```json
{
  "batching_policy": {
    "max_batch_tokens": 4096,
    "min_requests": 2,
    "timeout_ms": 20
  }
}
```
Arun (eng): add note: if p95 spikes, try timeout_ms=10 and reduce max_batch_tokens. also include SSE example:
```http
GET /v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY
Accept: text/event-stream
```
